data.narrative:
Project Omega, a Seed-stage nuclear energy company founded by Stafford Sheehan, has raised $12M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparative universe of 11 peers—3 public and 8 private—spanning the nuclear energy sector, including private companies such as Nano Nuclear Energy, Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, and X-Energy, as well as public benchmarks (OKLO, NNE, SMR).

Stage-progression analysis is the primary applicable method given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($12M) as a proxy baseline and applying a typical 2.5x step-up multiplier from Seed to next-stage financing, this method implies a valuation of $30M. A peer-median approach could not be reliably applied; while six same-sector peers exist, insufficient clustering around identical stage, adjacent stage, or comparable valuation tier prevented meaningful median extraction without risk of distortion.

The triangulated range supported by this analysis is $26M–$34M, centered on a median of $30M. This range reflects the single quantitative anchor available. Key uncertainties include the lack of granular comparables at identical stage and valuation tier within nuclear energy, which constrains precision. The analysis should be refreshed as additional Seed-stage nuclear energy valuations or Project Omega's own milestone progression become available.
